**Coaching Note (under 80 words):**

When the enemy king advances aggressively into the open, look for a knight check that forks another piece. The king must move, and you capture the forked piece cleanly. In this position, Nf5+ forces the king away while attacking the undefended d6 pawn—White wins material. Always scan for knight checks when the enemy king is exposed far from its pieces.
